style.backgroundSystem: misty light-blue wall #DCE4EE for hero and scene shots, warm beige #F5EFE6 for detail panels, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean home-textile bathroom visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty light-blue background #DCE4EE, warm beige panel #F5EFE6, deep navy text #2E3A50 and one amber-orange accent #F2A93B; bright soft daylight studio lighting with a gentle window-light feel, front-left key, soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end home textile photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for folded towels, upright hanging form for scene shots, consistent scale
style.surfaceSystem: matte painted wall, soft terry terry-loop fabric surfaces, light wood and ceramic bathroom props
